name: Corrected schema live site
description: Loads every public section from Supabase rather than hardcoded arrays.
expected: Hero, portfolio, services, about, process, testimonials, FAQ, CTA and footer reflect database values.

name: Visual inline editing
description: Edits text directly in the live site iframe.
expected: The field updates the matching Supabase row automatically and shows Saved.

name: Image replacement
description: Tap-friendly upload controls replace images through Supabase Storage.
expected: The image uploads to site-images, database URL updates, and image changes immediately.

name: Inline add
description: Adds blank repeatable records directly in the live layout.
expected: A new row is inserted into the correct table and appears inline for immediate editing.

name: Responsive editor
description: Keeps the visual CMS usable without hover.
expected: All controls remain reachable and image replacement works by tap.
